name: Plant care
description: Remembers when each plant was last watered, tells JoeBro which ones are due, and gives you a panel to tick them off.
author: joexk1

tools.name: plants_due
tools.description: List plants that are due (or overdue) for watering, with days since last watered. Use when the user asks about their plants or what needs doing at home.

tools.name: plant_watered
tools.description: Record that a plant was just watered. Use when the user says they watered a plant.

tools.name: plant_add
tools.description: Start tracking a plant and how often it needs water (days).

tools.name: plants_all
tools.description: Every tracked plant with its schedule and when it was last watered.

contributes.guardrail: When the user mentions having watered a plant, record it with plant_watered.
